name: Can victims recover hospital and medical costs after a car accident?

mainEntity.name: Can victims recover hospital and medical costs after a car accident?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. If another party is liable, injured victims may claim all immediate and future medical expenses for treatments, including hospitalization and therapy.mitchelllawcorp+1​
